Question Choices: Fill: A rectangle has a length of 7 cm and a width of 4 cm. What is the perimeter of the rectangle? (in cm)
Solution: Add all four sides:7+4+7+4=2 x(7+4)=22 linear units.

Question Choices: Select. The perimeter of a square is 32 feet. How long is each side of the square?: ~~2-feet | 4-feet | 8-feet | 10-feet~~
Hints: Divide the square perimeter by 4 to recover one side.
Solution: A square has four equal sides. Divide its 32-foot perimeter by 4:32/4=8 feet. Check:4 x 8=32.

Question Choices: Fill: The perimeter of a rectangular picture frame is 40 inches. The length of the frame is 12 inches. What is the width of the frame? (in inches)
Hints: Subtract both known lengths from the perimeter, then divide the rest by 2.
Solution: Two lengths use 2 x 12=24 inches. Subtract from perimeter:40-24=16. Two widths share that remainder, so each width is 8 inches. Check:2 x(12+8)=40.

Question Choices: Select. A square has a side length of 6 meters. What is the area of the square?: ~~24-square-meters | 30-square-meters | 36-square-meters | 42-square-meters~~
Hints: A square has equal length and width. Multiply the side by itself.
Solution: Area=length x width=6 x 6=36 square units. A square uses its same side for both factors.

Question Choices: Fill: A rectangular sticker is 9 inches long and 3 inches wide. What is the area of the sticker? (in square inches)
Hints: Multiply length by width; area uses square units.
Solution: Area=length x width=9 x 3=27 square units. This counts all unit squares in the rows.
